catalog_snapshot.classification_basis: Combat playable roster is reviewed against official playable-character and event-wish evidence; genshin-db presence alone is not sufficient. Miliastra Wonderland avatars are separately scoped.

scope_notes: This is a review queue, not an import manifest. No uncertain, unreleased, or NPC entries were found among the 124 source index records after cross-checking available official release evidence.
The genshin-db character index is not an exhaustive NPC or unreleased-character registry; NPCs absent from that index are not inferred or fabricated here.
